caption:
Crispy Garlic Butter Salmon 🐟

Ingredients:
- 2 salmon fillets (6oz each)
- 3 tbsp butter
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tsp paprika
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley for garnish
- 1 lemon

Saves and comments make my day! Follow @chefmike for more quick dinners ✨

transcript.text: Hey guys, welcome back to my channel!
Today I'm making the most amazing crispy salmon.
Start by patting your salmon fillets completely dry.
Season both sides generously with paprika, salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Once it's shimmering, place salmon skin side down.
Cook for about 4 minutes without moving it, trust me on this.
Flip it and cook another 2 minutes.
Add the butter and garlic, baste baste baste!
Like 30 seconds of basting and you're done.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley.
Save this recipe guys, it's so so good!
